create_KDTree: create a KDTree from a numpy array using KDTree64 or KDTree32 with specified leaf_size and metric
test_kd_tree_query: test the KDTree query method for finding k nearest neighbors with euclidean, manhattan, chebyshev, and minkowski metrics
test_kd_tree_query_radius: test the KDTree query_radius method for finding points within a given radius with return_distance support
test_kernel_density: test the KDTree kernel_density method for Gaussian kernel density estimation with breadth_first traversal
test_kdtree_picklable_joblib: test KDTree pickling compatibility with joblib Parallel for distributed memory-mapped queries
